item.title: Historic Great Fingall Mine outside Cue in the Murchison goes deeper than ever before
item.description: Mining at Great Fingall outside of Cue is reaching depths not seen for more than a century.

item.title: Three Geraldton schools turning trash into treasure thanks to State Government waste grants
item.description: Three Geraldton schools have been awarded a share of $150,000 of grants from the State Government to reduce waste and promote recycling.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Natasha Pirrottina: Be wary of scammers taking advantage of social media ban confusion
item.description: Just as you and the family are adjusting to this new social-media-free-world, another challenge emerges.

item.title: ‘Geraldton people just love Christmas on the Terrace’: Annual Marine Terrace tradition is another smash hit
item.description: Marine Terrace came alive on Thursday night as the annual Christmas on the Terrace filled the street with festive spirit. The busy foreshore was filled with families, stalls, and activations.

item.title: Metro, regional health services collaborate on new diagnostic technology for swallowing disorders in Mid West
item.description: Regional and metropolitan health services have collaborated on new virtual technology, allowing people in the Mid West experiencing swallowing difficulties to receive feedback and diagnoses in real time.

item.title: Geraldton gains four new firefighters a fortnight after bushfires tore through the town’s northern suburbs
item.description: Geraldton’s professional firefighting ranks has gained four new members after graduating from the WA Fire and Emergency Services Academy last Thursday evening.

item.title: Man, 63, dies and another man, also 63, injured in crash on Great Northern Highway in Paynes Find
item.description: One man had died and another is in hospital after a collision near Paynes Find.

item.title: Towns claim two wins in weekend’s Geraldton T20 and one-day cricket competitions
item.description: It was a productive weekend for Towns, who took out two wins over the weekend in the T20 and one-day competitions

item.title: Marlins complete championship clean sweep, winning both under-13s and under-10s T-ball grand finals
item.description: The Geraldton T-ball season wrapped up on Saturday morning at the Utakarra softball diamonds, with Marlins completing a clean sweep of the grand finals in both the under-13s and under-10s competitions.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association: Hometown heroes shine as WA State under-18s squad comes to town
item.description: Softball fans in Geraldton were treated to a strong weekend of representative action as Softball WA’s State under-18 side rolled into town to take on local GSA teams across a series of games at Utakarra.
